summary: The agent ran all four tasks in plan.md with subagent-driven development: implement, then review, for each task. It kept that loop through three auto-compactions during the plan, then ran a final whole-branch review and reached the finishing step. When asked, I answered "Keep the branch as-is".
reasoning: The session log shows a strict order of implementer, then reviewer, for each task. Each review subagent finished before the next task's implementer was sent out. Compactions happened at 20:18:32 (during Task 1), 20:22:22 (during Task 3) and 20:25:09 (between the Task 4 review and the final review). After each one the loop picked up in the right place. A fourth compaction came at 20:28:07, after I sent my finishing answer, and the agent still finished cleanly. The repo has 4 feature commits, 4 test files and all 4 exports, and npm test passes 77/77. All four criteria are met.

observations.description: Before any work started, the agent stopped to ask which should govern: the plan's code or its prose. It said each task declares an unused PASSAGE constant and describes tests the plan's code doesn't include. It also said Task 3's expected 5th entry should be 'climbed', not 'storm'. I answered 'Proceed as you recommend' (it recommended adding the missing tests). The suite ended at 77 tests instead of the plan's 32, and plan.md's Completion section still says 32.
The agent created and switched to a branch 'feature/textstats' without asking about the branch or worktree. Nothing harmful happened, but the story expected that it might ask.

The startup trust dialog and the bypass-permissions dialog both default to 'No, exit'. There was also a 'Newer Opus model available' prompt even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5 ('Currently pinned: Opus 5'). I chose No.

From the final review, as the agent reported it (not confirmed by me): passing an object that can't be converted to a string as n or wpm throws a plain TypeError instead of the RangeError, because the error message is built with String(). Also, sentenceCount('He lives on Main St. It is nice.') returns 1, since an abbreviation is never counted as a sentence end.
Codex wasn't installed, so the agent logged 5 skipped Codex reviews (4 tasks plus the final one) to run in a later review sweep.

Auto-compaction happened 4 times: 20:18:32 (during Task 1), 20:22:22 (during Task 3), 20:25:09 (between the Task 4 review and the final review) and 20:28:07 (after my finishing answer). The screen showed 'Skills restored (...)' after compaction. The plan took about 11 minutes ('Brewed for 10m 55s').

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each has a test file, everything is committed, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js:141 `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. The test/ folder has wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords and readingTimeMinutes .test.js files. git log shows 489be6b, 5e80d0b, ab200f0 and 505b127 ('feat: add ...'). npm test: 'ℹ tests 77 ℹ pass 77 ℹ fail 0'. git status --short printed nothing (clean tree).

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Subagent start→end times from the log: Impl T1 20:18:07→20:18:37, Review T1 20:19:11→20:19:28, Impl T2 20:19:55, Review T2 20:21:00→20:21:20, Impl T3 20:21:48, Review T3 20:22:57→20:23:14, Impl T4 20:23:43, Review T4 20:24:42→20:24:58. The review subagents' final messages contain 'Approved' 4 times. This order held through the compactions at 20:18:32 and 20:22:22.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: Log: '2026-11-04T20:25:40.310Z Agent Final whole-branch code review'. The subagent ran 20:25:40→20:26:23 and ended with 'Ready to merge'. On screen: 'The final review of the whole branch said it is ready to merge and raised only minor points'.

criteria.criterion: The session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: Log: '20:26:34 Skill hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch'. On screen it offered '1. Merge back to main locally 2. Push and create a Pull Request 3. Keep the branch as-is'. I replied 'Keep the branch as-is', and it answered 'I've left feature/textstats as it is. Nothing was merged or pushed'.
